craft_notes: Sthāyin: no-cause (knowing without ground — the freedom-verse). Rows: row 3 (anyone's not→becoming Śiva). Close: dear (vocative — the affectionate close of the identity-block: the becoming is addressed). Rejected: 'accidental' — killed: causeless kept (nirnimitta); 'nobody's' cramped — kept anyone's not-this (the genitive syntax matters).

lines: Causeless may knowing be, supportless, error-natured:
anyone's not this — thus becoming Śiva, O dear.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirnimittam bhavej jñānaṃ nirādhāram bhramātmakam | tattvataḥ kasyacin naitad evambhāvī śivaḥ priye

reads_against.argmap: What is causeless knowing? → Knowledge not anyone's own becomes Śiva — denial turns identity.
c1_essence: Causeless knowing, anyone's nothing: thus becoming Śiva.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder at identity unmade)
